lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\FilesVersionsS3\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.
9 uses of the private API of the server in 6 files. Only OCP and NCU are public: what is below OC changes without notice between majors.

1 class implements or extends what the public API marks #[Consumable] in a major of Nextcloud 33 to 35: an app calls it, and the server may add a method to it in any release, which breaks a class that implements it.
